description: Global StackVo settings living in <root>/.env — contract v1. Flat KEY=VALUE, no quoting, no interpolation, no multi-line values (both the Bash loader and the Node parser split naively on the first '='). Every key below is typed, defaulted, and tagged with its consumer so the Rust config loader and the Bash CLI cannot drift.

rules: Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
Split on the FIRST '='; everything after it is the value, verbatim, trimmed.
Values are NEVER quoted. A quoted value keeps its quotes and will be wrong.
'true'/'false' are the only accepted booleans (lowercase). Anything else is falsy.
List values are comma-separated with no spaces after the comma.
parsing.note: docker compose --env-file consumes the same file, so keys must also be valid Compose interpolation names: ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$.

statusLegend.active: Read by at least one component today.
statusLegend.dead: Present in .env.example but nothing in the checkout reads it. Measured by tools/measure-env-usage.mjs, not by hand — the hand-run version of this was wrong for 12 keys.
statusLegend.conflicting: Active, but overlaps or contradicts another key — see CONFLICTS.md.

DEFAULT_TLD_SUFFIX.description: The TLD every service router and admin-UI template builds its hostname from (traefik.stackvo.loc, adminer.stackvo.loc…). Project domains do NOT use it — those are written literally into stackvo.json, which is why changing this moves the tool URLs but not the projects.

SSL_ENABLE.description: Emit TLS routers and self-signed certs.

LETSENCRYPT_ENABLE.description: No ACME resolver is generated. Meaningless for .loc domains.

DEFAULT_PHP_VERSION.description: Fallback PHP version. Contradicts SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES_PHP_DEFAULT=8.4 — see C-12.

DEFAULT_WEB_SERVER.description: Third spelling of the same idea (DEFAULT_SERVER, SUPPORTED_SERVERS_DEFAULT). No consumers.

DEFAULT_CACHE_SERVER.description: Value is also nonsensical (mysql is not a cache). Delete.

STACKVO_UI_ENABLE.v1Change: The Tauri desktop app makes the containerised UI optional. When the desktop app is the front end this SHOULD be set to false; the app itself never reads this key.

SYSTEM_COMMAND_TIMEOUT.description: Never applied. Real build timeouts are hardcoded (nginx proxy_read_timeout 600s).

CACHE_TTL.description: Default node-cache TTL in the UI server. Individual call sites still override it (docker_stats uses 2s), so raising this does not slow every cache.

LOG_LEVEL.note: Bash uses uppercase, pino expects lowercase. Readers MUST lowercase before handing to pino.

TRAEFIK_URL.description: Dashboard subdomain, never wired up. Traefik's api.dashboard=true is set unconditionally in compose/base.yml.

DOCKER_DEFAULT_NETWORK.description: External network; must be created before `up`.

DOCKER_FORCE_RECREATE.description: Dead. `up` passes --force-recreate unconditionally in some paths and never reads this.

DOCKER_REMOVE_ORPHANS.description: Dead. --remove-orphans is hardcoded in the `up` command.

HOST_UID.description: UID the UI container chowns generated files to. WRONG BY DEFAULT ON macOS, where the first user is 501. Exists only because the UI runs as root inside a container.
HOST_UID.v1Change: OBSOLETE in the desktop app — it writes files as the invoking user. Keep the key only while the containerised UI still ships.

HOST_TIMEZONE.description: Dead: no template interpolates it. Containers inherit UTC unless their image says otherwise.

ALLOWED_PHP_VERSIONS.description: Duplicates SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES_PHP_VERSIONS with a DIFFERENT range (missing 5.6-7.3 and 8.5). Nothing enforces it. Delete — see C-11 and C-12.

hostPorts._note: Host-published ports for services that expose one. Only these five are parameterised; other services hardcode their port in the template or use SERVICE_<NAME>_HOST_PORT instead — an inconsistency v1 should unify.

HOST_PORT_PERCONA.description: There is no Percona service or template.

HOST_PORT_ADMINER.description: Dead: the Adminer template reads SERVICE_ADMINER_HOST_PORT instead. Two keys for one port, only one of them wired.

STACKVO_DRY_RUN.description: A real dry-run mode would be genuinely useful in the desktop app — implement it rather than deleting the key.

STACKVO_VERSION.description: Dead inside StackVo itself, but the desktop app reads it from .env to show which checkout it is driving.

catalog._note: The capability catalog the UI renders in the new-project form (GET /api/supported-languages). This is REFERENCE DATA masquerading as configuration — it describes what StackVo can build, not what the user configured. v1 keeps the keys for compatibility but the desktop app reads catalog.json instead.

SUPPORTED_SERVERS.description: Matches the generators on disk exactly. Authoritative.

SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES.description: Advertises SIX runtimes; only php and nodejs have generators. Selecting python/go/ruby/rust in the UI produces a broken project — see C-02.

SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES_PHP_VERSIONS.description: Offers 5.6-7.4, but php-extensions.sh assumes 8.0+ throughout (is_builtin_extension defaults to 8.0). See C-13.

SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES_PHP_EXTENSIONS.description: The pickable extension catalog. MUST be a subset of the keys in php-extensions.json — enforced by tools/validate-contracts.mjs.

SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES_PHP_EXTENSIONS_DEFAU.description: Pre-checked set in the UI. Contains 'imap', which is removed in PHP 8.2+ while the default PHP is 8.4 — the out-of-the-box selection cannot build. See C-06.

SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES_NODEJS_DEFAULT.note: The env KEY says NODEJS but the stackvo.json manifest key is 'node'. See C-01.

PHP_DEFAULT_TOOLS.description: Recognised values: composer, nodejs, git, wget, unzip. Unknown values silently produce nothing.

PHP_DEFAULT_APT_PACKAGES.description: Baked into every PHP image. Includes debugging tools (strace, vim, nano, htop) — appropriate for a dev environment, but it is ~200MB of image weight worth making opt-in.

PHP_TOOL_NODEJS_VERSION.description: Node bundled INSIDE the PHP image. Differs from SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES_NODEJS_DEFAULT=22 — intentional or not, it is undocumented. See C-12.

servicePattern.description: Every service is configured by a SERVICE_<NAME>_* key family. <NAME> is the service id uppercased with '-' replaced by '_' (mongo-express -> MONGO_EXPRESS).

SERVICE_<NAME>_ENABLE.description: Gates BOTH generation and the compose profile. The CLI derives `--profile <name-lowercased>` from every key matching ^SERVICE_([A-Z_]+)_ENABLE$ set to true.

SERVICE_<NAME>_URL.description: Traefik subdomain label; present on web-facing tools only.

SERVICE_<NAME>_HOST_PORT.description: Host-published port. Coexists inconsistently with the HOST_PORT_<NAME> family — v1 SHOULD standardise on this one.

profileDerivation.rule: SERVICE_MONGO_EXPRESS_ENABLE=true yields `--profile mongo_express`, but the compose profile in the template is `mongo-express`. Underscore vs dash: verify per service — see C-09.

services._note: 20 services have templates under core/templates/services/. The README's '40+ Ready Services' badge and its '14 services' table are both wrong; 20 is the real number.

serviceDependencies._note: core/ui/server/config/serviceDependencies.json declares only 3 entries and references a 'prometheus' service that does not exist. Six admin UIs have hard dependencies that are undeclared, so the UI happily starts them against nothing. v1 completes the graph.

phpmyadmin.note: SERVICE_PHPMYADMIN_HOST points at stackvo-mysql by default but ARBITRARY=1 allows any host.

secrets.policy: This file contains credentials (SERVICE_*_PASSWORD, *_TOKEN, *_SERVER_ID). It is gitignored and MUST stay so. The desktop app MUST redact any key matching /(PASSWORD|PASS|TOKEN|SECRET|SERVER_ID)$/ in logs, telemetry and error reports.
secrets.committedSecretWarning: SERVICE_BLACKFIRE_SERVER_ID and SERVICE_BLACKFIRE_SERVER_TOKEN carry real-looking values in .env.example. If those are live Blackfire credentials they are published in the repo and must be rotated.

_measurement.method: tools/measure-env-usage.mjs — literal grep over the checkout's core/, plus an explicit allowance for the SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES_* family, which supported-languages.js builds from a template string.
_measurement.note: The first pass of this measurement was run from the wrong working directory and reported zero consumers for every key, which made 17 keys look dead. Two of them (DEFAULT_TLD_SUFFIX, CACHE_TTL) were live, and two keys marked active (CACHE_ENABLE, LOG_ENABLE) were dead. Re-run the tool rather than trusting the labels.
